items.title: T-Mobile CTO Gives SpaceX a Reality Check on Its Starlink Mobile Ambitions
items.snippet: John Saw pours cold water on SpaceX's plan to become a major US wireless carrier using recently acquired spectrum. It might sound like sour grapes, but financial analysts are similarly skeptical.

items.title: Elon Musk’s growing SpaceX empire sends AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares plunging
items.snippet: Elon Musk’s plan for SpaceX to become a major mobile carrier sent shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile plunging and wiped out over $50 billion before lunch.

items.title: SpaceX eyes near back-to-back rocket launches in California. Watch live
items.snippet: SpaceX could be eyeing two rocket launches in three days from the Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Here's how to watch the action live.

items.title: SpaceX spectrum deal to expand its Starlink network in the US sends telecom stocks tumbling
items.snippet: Telecom giants saw shares tumble on news that Elon Musk's company reached a deal that would allow it to expand its reach in the US market.

items.title: SpaceX brings recovered Starship home to Texas after ocean saga
items.snippet: The upper section of SpaceX's Starship rocket has made it home to Texas after its recovery on the other side of the world following a flight test.

items.title: SpaceX Wants To Become A 'Major Mobile Carrier' With Low-Band Spectrum Acquisition
items.snippet: SpaceX has revealed its plans to become a major mobile carrier.

items.title: Elon Musk Wants Grok Bot to Route Users to Rival AI Models
items.snippet: Elon Musk plans to expand Grok Bot with routing to rival AI models, including Claude. The move raises questions about user privacy and AI competition.

items.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX just made a big move to become a mobile carrier heavyweight in the US
items.snippet: SpaceX has reportedly agreed to pay around $8 billion for cellular spectrum licences, bringing Elon Musk’s company closer to competing with major US mobile carriers.

items.title: SpaceX’s Starlink Mobile plans are pressuring AT&T and Verizon shares
items.snippet: SpaceX plans to purchase Grain Management’s 800 MHz spectrum portfolio in a move to bolster its mobile ambitions. The news is lifting cell-tower stocks.

items.title: SpaceX announces plan to become a ‘major mobile carrier’
items.snippet: SpaceX snapped up low-band spectrum in a bid to take on T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.

items.title: Elon Musk’s 250,000 Cybertruck goal falls well short: New data shows only 13% of goal sold annually
items.snippet: Elon Musk had ambitious goals for the Cybertruck, the electric pickup truck released by Tesla Inc TSLA in 2023. Three years later, the goals have been crushed and demand remains well below ambitious ...
